stem: Business Care's MRR table has one row per business per month with MRR above 0. A business paid €40 in May, nothing in June, and €40 in July. An analyst takes last month's MRR with LAG over each business's own rows, with no business × month grid. What does the analysis record for this business in June and July?

options.text: Churn of €40 in June and reactivation of €40 in July, as it should
No movement in either month: the churn and the return are both missed
New business of €40 in July, because June has no row to compare it with
Contraction of €40 in June and expansion of €40 in July
